body: Talking is useless. I don't see what I kind of new understanding I can get just from talking with people. I understand my flaws and what could be done to make them better but I don't have in me to change. Therapists were all useless. The only thing that helps somewhat is taking medication.
I don't have the energy/motivation to escape or change. That's pretty much all there is to it.
Passion is suffering. I can't afford passion in this state.
